events.speaker: sable
events.message: The first console is ours. Keep both bays occupied; the second controller must agree before the safety circuit can come back.

events.speaker: vale
events.message: Three machines through the north container aisle. Machine gun and two pistols.

events.speaker: vale
events.message: Another three through the southern stacks. Keep the two control bays covered.

events.speaker: sable
events.message: Both cranes released. The work lights are on the approaches and the loaders have their jobs back. Gannet's night hold is recorded against their own dispatch instruction. Return through the service gate.

events.speaker: vale
events.message: Three more at the west service lane. They're moving to cut off the gate. Bring the operators back together before you return.
